plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Communication Studies 2.0 AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8041/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+16+15+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 CalGETC Area 2 Math Competency 3-4 -> 3). COMM 311 lists ENGL C1000 as a prerequisite; ENGL C1000 is not a named plan course (the plan sequences a CalGETC Area 1A English Composition GE choice, which is typically ENGL C1000) and is carried under external_prereqs. List A (minimum 9 units): COMM 311, COMM 315 (requires ENGL C1000), COMM 325, COMM 331 (advisory ENGL C1000), COMM 363 (advisory ENGL C1000), JOUR 310 or RTVF 300 (Mass Media and Society). List B (minimum 3 units, not already taken in List A): ANTH 310, COMM 311, COMM 315, COMM 325, COMM 331, COMM 341 (eligibility for ENGL C1000), COMM 361 (advisory eligible for ENGL C1000), COMM 363, ENGL C1001 (requires ENGL C1000), JOUR 300 (advisory eligibility for ENGL C1000), PSYC C1000 (advisory ENGRD 310/312, ENGL C1000, or equivalent), SOC 300, JOUR 310 or RTVF 300. Note: COMM 311, COMM 315, COMM 325, and COMM 331 are both required major courses AND List A/B members; List A/B choice slots must be filled with courses not already taken. Semester 2 'Any transferable elective' and Semester 3 '3 units from List A or elective' and Semester 4 '3 units from List A or transferable Elective': a transferable elective not from List A/B may substitute; units needed to total 60 for graduation. Semester 4 Area 4 footnote: six units from two different disciplines are required for Area 4; map suggests PSYC 300 General Principles from List B. Semester 4 Area 3A suggestion: FMS 300 or RTVF 305. Semester 3 Area 3B suggestion: ENGWR 301 (pre-req ENGWR 300, ENGWR 480, ESLW 340, or HONOR 375). Advisories are recommendations only, recorded in choice_notes, never as prereqs. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor. This map also meets the Certificate of Achievement in Applied Communication Skills with the selection/addition of COMM 341 and 361 from List A/B (no separate sequence published).
